title: soldanella pusilla subsp. alpicola
intro: Soldanella pusilla subsp. alpicola, commonly known as Alpine Soldanella, is a plant species belonging to the Primulaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in the Alps, for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Soldanella include soothing and calming effects, making it useful for treating skin irritations, wounds, and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
